description:
Don’t choose between speed and comfort: with CAEDANHA T, you get both. The high-modulus carbon frame absorbs terrain vibrations to reduce fatigue, ensuring a smooth and responsive ride even after hours in the saddle. Thanks to generous tire clearance and a full suite of bikepacking mounts, it’s ready for anything: from quick after-work rides to epic continental crossings. Pack your bags, plot your route on the map, and set off. Where the road ends, the real journey begins.

For CAEDANHA T, we selected matte colorways and finishes designed to blend into nature and embrace the dust of your best miles. Pick your companion, get ready to get it dirty.

If our curated combinations aren’t enough, start with a blank canvas. From colour selection to finishes (matte, gloss or mixed), right down to the finest graphic details, we’ll create a Carrera that’s uniquely yours.

Equipped with integrated frame and fork mounts for bags, racks, and mudguards, it adapts to any adventure. From weekend escapes to grand continental expeditions, you’ll never run short on storage.

From S to XL, the Caedanha T monocoque frame is calibrated to offer every rider the same balance between aerodynamics and power transfer. If you already know your biomechanical measurements, use the Stack and Reach values as a reference to identify your size.
